sources.snippet: A small chat model trained from scratch with train_llm, following karpathy/nanochat: 24 layers, width 1536, about 2.1B parameters (most in value-embedding tables; the Transformer and output head are about 0.78B). English only. chat_t2i_v9.ckpt is the final model.
